- undated · touches · "We should eaily be able to export an essay - and all relevant content should be immediately availbale." (None)
- 2026-11-04 · retells · "The essay view probably needs to become something I can plug into mudemocracy and semanticops websites." (Vignette 2026-11-04: the editor is how people experience the whole stack; essays are dogfood, and an essay is a presentation of the stack on our websites)
- 2026-11-04 · retells · "create an "ideas" section on the mudemocracy site that allows me to publish read only essays" (Vignette 2026-11-04: an ideas section on the muDemocracy site publishes read-only essays, each available at an srs url)
